source.text: מַשָּׂ֖א גֵּ֣יא חִזָּי֑וֹן מַה־לָּ֣ךְ אֵפ֔וֹא כִּֽי־עָלִ֥ית כֻּלָּ֖ךְ לַגַּגּֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] oracle of [the] valley of vision. What [is] to you now, that you have gone up, all of you, to the roofs,

en.L: The oracle [concerning] the valley of vision. \q What [is the matter] with you now, \q that you have gone up, all of you, to the roofs?
en.B: An oracle about the valley of vision. \q What is wrong with you now, \q that all of you have climbed up onto the roofs?
en.R: This is a message about the valley of vision, that is, Jerusalem. \q What is happening to you, people of Jerusalem? \q Why have all of you gone up onto your flat roofs?

es.L: Oráculo [sobre] el valle de la visión. \q ¿Qué [te pasa] ahora, \q que has subido toda tú a las azoteas?
es.B: Oráculo sobre el valle de la visión. \q ¿Qué te pasa ahora, \q que toda tú has subido a las azoteas?
es.R: Este es un mensaje sobre el valle de la visión, es decir, Jerusalén. \q ¿Qué te pasa, pueblo de Jerusalén? \q ¿Por qué han subido todos a las azoteas de sus casas?

fr.L: Oracle [concernant] la vallée de la vision. \q Qu’as-tu donc maintenant, \q que tu sois montée, tout entière, sur les toits ?
fr.B: Oracle sur la vallée de la vision. \q Qu’as-tu donc maintenant, \q pour être montée tout entière sur les toits ?
fr.R: Message au sujet de la vallée de la vision, c’est-à-dire Jérusalem. \q Que se passe-t-il, habitants de Jérusalem ? \q Pourquoi êtes-vous tous montés sur vos toits en terrasse ?

sw.L: Unabii [juu ya] bonde la maono. \q Mna [nini] sasa, \q hata mmepanda, nyote, juu ya dari?
sw.B: Unabii kuhusu bonde la maono. \q Mna shida gani sasa, \q hata nyote mmepanda juu ya dari za nyumba?
sw.R: Ujumbe kuhusu bonde la maono, yaani, Yerusalemu. \q Ni nini kinachowapata, enyi watu wa Yerusalemu? \q Kwa nini nyote mmepanda juu ya dari za nyumba zenu?

vi.L: Sấm ngôn [về] thung lũng khải tượng. \q Các ngươi bây giờ [có chuyện] gì, \q mà các ngươi đều đã leo lên các mái nhà?
vi.B: Sấm ngôn về thung lũng khải tượng. \q Bây giờ các ngươi bị sao vậy, \q mà tất cả đều trèo lên mái nhà?
vi.R: Đây là sứ điệp về thung lũng khải tượng, tức là Giê-ru-sa-lem. \q Hỡi dân Giê-ru-sa-lem, chuyện gì đang xảy ra với các ngươi? \q Sao tất cả các ngươi đều leo lên mái nhà bằng của mình?

decisions.choice: oracle: a solemn message from God announced against a place
decisions.reason: The word comes from the verb "to lift up" and heads each of the oracles about the nations in chapters 13-23 (see the note at 13:1). In 22:25 the same word means a load hung on a peg.

decisions.choice: the valley of vision: Jerusalem, the place where the prophet saw his visions
alternatives: a valley near Jerusalem where a vision came
decisions.reason: The oracles before this one are about foreign nations, but verses 8-11 name Judah, the city of David and Jerusalem. Jerusalem sits on hills ringed by valleys (verse 7); the name may be ironic, since the city that received visions did not see (verse 11).

decisions.choice: to the roofs: up onto the flat roofs of the houses
decisions.reason: Houses had flat roofs used for living and work. The people climb up to watch, whether to celebrate (verse 2) or to see the enemy (verses 6-7).

decisions.choice: message
decisions.reason: As at 13:1, Readable says "message"; Literal and Balanced say "oracle".

decisions.choice: that is, Jerusalem / people of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Readable names the city that verses 9-10 identify, so the reader knows who is addressed.

decisions.choice: te; has subido toda tú
decisions.reason: The Hebrew addresses the city as one woman (feminine singular), so Spanish keeps "tú" at L and B; at R the people of Jerusalem are spoken of in the third person.

decisions.choice: "tu", feminine ("montée"), for the city addressed
decisions.reason: The Hebrew addresses the city as one woman; French keeps the singular and the feminine agreement. Readable turns to the people of Jerusalem with "vous", as the English Readable names them.

decisions.choice: "các ngươi" to the people of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Here God's oracle addresses the city and its people as a group, so it is "các ngươi" at every level, as the terms note sets for God speaking to the people; the prophet's own grief in verse 4 says "tôi".

source.text: תְּשֻׁא֣וֹת׀מְלֵאָ֗ה עִ֚יר הֽוֹמִיָּ֔ה קִרְיָ֖ה עַלִּיזָ֑ה חֲלָלַ֨יִךְ֙ לֹ֣א חַלְלֵי־חֶ֔רֶב וְלֹ֖א מֵתֵ֥י מִלְחָמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: noises full, city turbulent, town exultant, your slain [are] not slain of [the] sword, and not dead of battle.

en.L: [You who are] full of noises, turbulent city, exultant town, \q your slain [are] not slain by [the] sword, and not dead in battle.
en.B: You are full of shouting, a city in uproar, a town in high spirits. \q Your dead were not cut down by the sword or killed in battle.
en.R: The whole city is noisy and wild with excitement. \q But your people who have died were not killed by swords. They did not die fighting in a battle.

es.L: [Tú, llena] de estruendo, ciudad turbulenta, villa alborozada, \q tus muertos no [son] muertos a espada, ni muertos en batalla.
es.B: Estás llena de gritos, ciudad alborotada, villa llena de júbilo. \q Tus muertos no cayeron a espada ni murieron en batalla.
es.R: Toda la ciudad está llena de ruido y de alboroto. \q Pero tu gente que ha muerto no murió a espada. No murieron peleando en una batalla.

fr.L: [Toi qui es] pleine de vacarme, ville tumultueuse, cité joyeuse, \q tes morts [ne sont] pas tués par l’épée, et ne sont pas morts au combat.
fr.B: Tu es pleine de cris, ville en effervescence, cité en fête. \q Tes morts ne sont pas tombés sous l’épée, ils n’ont pas été tués au combat.
fr.R: Toute la ville est bruyante et folle d’excitation. \q Mais vos morts n’ont pas été tués par l’épée. Ils ne sont pas morts en se battant dans une bataille.

sw.L: [Wewe uliyejaa] makelele, mji wenye ghasia, mji wa shangwe, \q waliouawa wako [si] waliouawa kwa upanga, wala si waliokufa vitani.
sw.B: Umejaa makelele, mji wenye ghasia, mji uliojaa furaha ya kelele. \q Wafu wako hawakuuawa kwa upanga wala hawakufa vitani.
sw.R: Mji wote una kelele na msisimko usio na kiasi. \q Lakini watu wako waliokufa hawakuuawa kwa panga. Hawakufa wakipigana vitani.

vi.L: [Hỡi thành] đầy tiếng ồn ào, thành náo động, thành vui reo, \q những kẻ bị giết của ngươi [đã] không bị giết bởi gươm, cũng không chết trong chiến trận.
vi.B: Ngươi đầy tiếng hò hét, là thành náo loạn, là thành hớn hở vui mừng. \q Những người chết của ngươi không ngã dưới lưỡi gươm, cũng không tử trận.
vi.R: Cả thành ồn ào và cuồng nhiệt vui chơi. \q Nhưng những người của ngươi đã chết không phải bị giết bằng gươm. Họ không chết khi chiến đấu ngoài trận mạc.

decisions.choice: full of noises ... exultant town: a city of loud, careless celebration
decisions.reason: The same words describe Tyre (23:7) and a proud city brought low (32:13). The city rejoices while disaster is coming (verse 13).

decisions.choice: your slain not slain by the sword: your dead did not die fighting
alternatives: your dead died of famine and disease
decisions.reason: The word for "slain" usually means someone pierced in battle. Here the dead did not fall in combat; the next verse suggests they were caught fleeing, and siege also brought death by hunger and disease (Lamentations 4:9).

decisions.choice: noisy and wild with excitement
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what the three titles of the city describe.

source.text: כָּל־קְצִינַ֥יִךְ נָֽדְדוּ־יַ֖חַד מִקֶּ֣שֶׁת אֻסָּ֑רוּ כָּל־נִמְצָאַ֨יִךְ֙ אֻסְּר֣וּ יַחְדָּ֔ו מֵרָח֖וֹק בָּרָֽחוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: All your rulers have fled together; without [the] bow they have been captured; all [those] found in you were captured together; from afar they had fled.

en.L: All your rulers have fled together; without [a] bow they have been captured. \q All [those] found in you were captured together; far away they had fled.
en.B: All your leaders ran away together and were taken prisoner without a bow being drawn. \q All of you who were found were captured together, though they had fled far away.
en.R: All your leaders ran away together. They were captured without a fight. \q Everyone who was found was taken prisoner, even those who had run far away.

es.L: Todos tus gobernantes han huido juntos; sin [el] arco han sido capturados. \q Todos [los] que fueron hallados en ti fueron capturados juntos; lejos habían huido.
es.B: Todos tus jefes huyeron juntos y fueron hechos prisioneros sin que se tensara un arco. \q Todos los tuyos que fueron hallados fueron capturados juntos, aunque habían huido lejos.
es.R: Todos tus jefes huyeron juntos. Los capturaron sin pelear. \q Todos los que fueron encontrados quedaron prisioneros, incluso los que habían huido lejos.

fr.L: Tous tes chefs ont fui ensemble ; sans arc ils ont été faits prisonniers. \q Tous [ceux qu’on a] trouvés en toi ont été faits prisonniers ensemble ; au loin ils avaient fui.
fr.B: Tous tes chefs se sont enfuis ensemble et ont été capturés sans qu’on tende un arc. \q Tous les tiens qu’on a trouvés ont été capturés ensemble, bien qu’ils aient fui au loin.
fr.R: Tous vos chefs se sont enfuis ensemble. Ils ont été capturés sans combat. \q Tous ceux qu’on a trouvés ont été faits prisonniers, même ceux qui s’étaient enfuis loin.

sw.L: Watawala wako wote wamekimbia pamoja; bila upinde wametekwa. \q Wote walioonekana ndani yako walitekwa pamoja; walikuwa wamekimbia mbali.
sw.B: Viongozi wako wote walikimbia pamoja, wakatekwa bila upinde kuvutwa. \q Wote wako walioonekana walitekwa pamoja, ingawa walikuwa wamekimbia mbali.
sw.R: Viongozi wako wote walikimbia pamoja. Walikamatwa bila kupigana. \q Kila mtu aliyepatikana alichukuliwa mateka, hata wale waliokuwa wamekimbia mbali.

vi.L: Mọi kẻ cai trị của ngươi đã cùng nhau chạy trốn; không [cần] cung, chúng đã bị bắt. \q Mọi [người] được tìm thấy trong ngươi đều bị bắt cùng nhau; họ đã chạy trốn đến nơi xa.
vi.B: Mọi người lãnh đạo của ngươi cùng nhau bỏ chạy, và bị bắt làm tù binh mà không một mũi tên nào được bắn ra. \q Mọi người của ngươi bị tìm thấy đều bị bắt cả, dù họ đã chạy trốn thật xa.
vi.R: Mọi người lãnh đạo của ngươi đều cùng nhau bỏ chạy. Họ bị bắt mà không hề chống cự. \q Ai bị tìm thấy cũng đều bị bắt làm tù binh, kể cả những người đã chạy trốn thật xa.

decisions.choice: without the bow: captured without a shot being fired
decisions.reason: The preposition can mean "from" or "without". The leaders surrendered without fighting. It may instead mean "by the bowmen", captured by archers.

decisions.choice: your rulers have fled: the leaders desert the city
decisions.reason: When Babylon broke into Jerusalem in 587/586 BC, King Zedekiah and his soldiers fled by night and were captured near Jericho (2 Kings 25:4-6). Whether Isaiah sees that event or a similar flight in 701 BC, the leaders' flight is part of the city's shame.

decisions.choice: without a fight
decisions.reason: Readable explains "without a bow".

source.text: עַל־כֵּ֥ן אָמַ֛רְתִּי שְׁע֥וּ מִנִּ֖י אֲמָרֵ֣ר בַּבֶּ֑כִי אַל־תָּאִ֣יצוּ לְנַֽחֲמֵ֔נִי עַל־שֹׁ֖ד בַּת־עַמִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore I said, look away from me; I will be bitter in weeping; do not hasten to comfort me over [the] destruction of [the] daughter of my people.

en.L: Therefore I said, "Look away from me; I will be bitter in weeping. \q Do not hurry to comfort me \q over the destruction of the daughter of my people."
en.B: So I said, "Turn your eyes away from me; leave me to my bitter weeping. \q Do not rush to comfort me \q for the ruin of the daughter of my people."
en.R: So I said, "Leave me alone, and let me cry hard. \q Do not try to comfort me. \q My people have been destroyed."

es.L: Por eso dije: «{{plural_you:Aparten|Apartad}} de mí la mirada; lloraré amargamente. \q No {{plural_you:se apresuren|os apresuréis}} a consolarme \q por la destrucción de la hija de mi pueblo».
es.B: Por eso dije: «{{plural_you:Aparten|Apartad}} de mí los ojos; {{plural_you:déjenme|dejadme}} en mi amargo llanto. \q No {{plural_you:corran|corráis}} a consolarme \q por la ruina de la hija de mi pueblo».
es.R: Por eso dije: «{{plural_you:Déjenme|Dejadme}} solo, y {{plural_you:dejen|dejad}} que llore con amargura. \q No {{plural_you:traten|tratéis}} de consolarme. \q Mi pueblo ha sido destruido».

fr.L: C’est pourquoi j’ai dit : « Détournez de moi le regard ; je pleurerai amèrement. \q Ne vous hâtez pas de me consoler \q de la ruine de la fille de mon peuple. »
fr.B: Alors j’ai dit : « Détournez les yeux de moi ; laissez-moi pleurer amèrement. \q Ne vous pressez pas de me consoler \q de la ruine de la fille de mon peuple. »
fr.R: Alors j’ai dit : « Laissez-moi tranquille, laissez-moi pleurer de toutes mes forces. \q N’essayez pas de me consoler. \q Mon peuple est détruit. »

sw.L: Kwa hiyo nilisema, "Geuzeni macho mbali nami; nitalia kwa uchungu. \q Msiharakishe kunifariji \q juu ya maangamizi ya binti wa watu wangu."
sw.B: Kwa hiyo nilisema, "Geuzeni macho yenu mbali nami; niacheni nilie kwa uchungu. \q Msiharakishe kunifariji \q kwa ajili ya maangamizi ya watu wangu wapendwa."
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nilisema, "Niacheni peke yangu, nilie sana. \q Msijaribu kunifariji. \q Watu wangu wameangamizwa."

vi.L: Vì vậy tôi đã nói: "Hãy nhìn đi chỗ khác, đừng nhìn tôi; tôi sẽ khóc lóc đắng cay. \q Đừng vội an ủi tôi \q về sự hủy diệt của con gái dân tôi."
vi.B: Vì thế tôi nói: "Hãy quay mắt đi, đừng nhìn tôi; hãy để tôi khóc lóc đắng cay. \q Đừng vội an ủi tôi \q về sự tàn phá của con gái dân tôi."
vi.R: Vì vậy tôi nói: "Hãy để tôi yên, để tôi khóc thật nhiều. \q Đừng cố an ủi tôi. \q Dân tôi đã bị hủy diệt rồi."

decisions.choice: the daughter of my people: my people, spoken of tenderly
decisions.reason: The phrase pictures the people as a beloved daughter. Jeremiah uses it often in his laments over Jerusalem (Jeremiah 8:21-22; 9:1).

decisions.choice: I said: the prophet speaks for himself
decisions.reason: The prophet's own grief breaks into the oracle. It stands against the city's celebration in verses 2 and 13.

decisions.choice: my people
decisions.reason: Readable drops the picture of a daughter and says "my people"; Literal and Balanced keep it.

decisions.choice: la hija de mi pueblo
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the tender picture, as the English; Readable says "mi pueblo".

decisions.choice: "binti wa watu wangu" (L); "watu wangu wapendwa" (B); "watu wangu" (R)
alternatives: "binti wa watu wangu" at every level
decisions.reason: The English Balanced keeps "the daughter of my people", but in Swahili "binti" read plainly is a girl, so Balanced uses the wording the terms note sets for this phrase in Jeremiah, with "wapendwa" for the tenderness of the figure; Literal keeps "binti".

decisions.choice: "con gái dân tôi"
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the tender picture of the people as a daughter, as the English does, in the same pattern as "con gái Si-ôn"; Readable says "dân tôi".

source.text: כִּ֣י יוֹם֩ מְהוּמָ֨ה וּמְבוּסָ֜ה וּמְבוּכָ֗ה לַֽאדֹנָ֧י יְהוִ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת בְּגֵ֣יא חִזָּי֑וֹן מְקַרְקַ֥ר קִ֖ר וְשׁ֥וֹעַ אֶל־הָהָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: For a day of panic and trampling and confusion [belongs] to [the] Lord Yahweh of hosts in [the] valley of vision, breaking down [the] wall and crying out to the mountain.

en.L: For [it is] a day of panic and trampling and confusion [belonging] to the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of hosts in the valley of vision, \q a breaking down of [the] wall and a crying out to the mountain.
en.B: For the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies brings a day of panic and trampling and confusion to the valley of vision, \q a day when walls are broken through and cries ring out toward the mountain.
en.R: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies has chosen a day when people in the valley of vision will panic. They will be trampled and confused. \q Enemies will break down the city walls. People will scream for help toward the hills.

es.L: Porque [es] día de pánico, de pisoteo y de confusión [que pertenece] al Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos en el valle de la visión, \q de derribar [el] muro y de clamar al monte.
es.B: Porque el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos trae un día de pánico, de pisoteo y de confusión al valle de la visión, \q un día en que se derriban los muros y los gritos resuenan hacia el monte.
es.R: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos ha escogido un día en que la gente del valle de la visión se llenará de pánico. Serán pisoteados y quedarán confundidos. \q Los enemigos derribarán las murallas de la ciudad. La gente gritará pidiendo ayuda hacia los montes.

fr.L: Car [c’est] un jour de panique, de piétinement et de confusion [qui appartient] au Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées, dans la vallée de la vision, \q une démolition de muraille et un cri vers la montagne.
fr.B: Car le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées amène un jour de panique, de piétinement et de confusion sur la vallée de la vision, \q un jour où les murailles sont percées et où les cris montent vers la montagne.
fr.R: Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées a choisi un jour où les gens de la vallée de la vision seront pris de panique. Ils seront piétinés et perdus. \q Les ennemis démoliront les murailles de la ville. Les gens crieront au secours vers les collines.

sw.L: Kwa maana [ni] siku ya hofu kuu na ya kukanyagwa na ya machafuko [iliyo] ya Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi katika bonde la maono, \q ya kubomoa ukuta na ya kulia kuuelekea mlima.
sw.B: Kwa maana Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analeta siku ya hofu kuu, ya kukanyagwa na ya machafuko katika bonde la maono, \q siku ambayo kuta zinabomolewa na vilio vinasikika kuelekea mlimani.
sw.R: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi amechagua siku ambayo watu katika bonde la maono watashikwa na hofu kuu. Watakanyagwa na kuchanganyikiwa. \q Maadui watabomoa kuta za mji. Watu watapiga kelele kuelekea milimani wakiomba msaada.

vi.L: Vì [đó là] một ngày hoảng loạn, giày đạp và bối rối [thuộc về] Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân trong thung lũng khải tượng, \q [ngày] tường thành bị phá đổ và tiếng kêu la vọng đến núi.
vi.B: Vì Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đem đến cho thung lũng khải tượng một ngày hoảng loạn, giày xéo và rối ren, \q ngày tường thành bị chọc thủng và tiếng kêu cứu vang dội về phía núi.
vi.R: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã định một ngày mà dân trong thung lũng khải tượng sẽ hoảng loạn. Họ sẽ bị giày đạp và hoang mang. \q Quân thù sẽ phá đổ tường thành. Dân chúng sẽ kêu la cầu cứu về phía các ngọn đồi.

decisions.choice: a day ... belonging to the Lord: a day of the Lord's judgment
decisions.reason: The day belongs to God because he brings it, as in 2:12 and 13:6, 9. The enemy's attack is his work.

decisions.choice: panic and trampling and confusion: three words that sound alike
decisions.reason: The three nouns share sounds and build a picture of a crowd in terror, as in Micah 7:4.

decisions.choice: breaking down the wall and crying out to the mountain
alternatives: a crying to the mountains for help
decisions.reason: Both phrases are rare and their sense is debated. The first may mean an enemy battering down walls; the second may be cries for help that echo off the hills, or the shout of the attackers. The words also sound like "Kir" and "shield" in verse 6.

decisions.choice: Enemies will break down / People will scream
decisions.reason: Readable supplies the subjects of the two actions, following the most likely sense.

decisions.choice: el Señor DIOS de los ejércitos (L); de los Ejércitos (B, R)
decisions.reason: Adonai YHWH of hosts: "el Señor" followed by the divine_name span "DIOS

decisions.choice: "le Seigneur DIEU" with the divine_name span on "DIEU", for Isaiah 21-40
decisions.reason: As the terms note and the published books: Adonai with YHWH is "le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU

decisions.choice: "Chúa là CHÚA Vạn Quân", the span on "CHÚA" only
decisions.reason: Adonai with YHWH is "Chúa là CHÚA", as the Samuel and Psalms notes set, with "Vạn Quân" after it as in Psalm 69:7.

source.text: וְעֵילָם֙ נָשָׂ֣א אַשְׁפָּ֔ה בְּרֶ֥כֶב אָדָ֖ם פָּֽרָשִׁ֑ים וְקִ֥יר עֵרָ֖ה מָגֵֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And Elam took up [the] quiver, with chariotry of men, horsemen, and Kir laid bare [the] shield.

en.L: And Elam took up [the] quiver, with chariots of men [and] horsemen, \q and Kir laid bare [the] shield.
en.B: Elam shouldered its quiver, with chariots, men and horsemen, \q and Kir stripped the cover from its shield.
en.R: Soldiers from Elam came with their arrows. They had chariots and horsemen. \q Soldiers from Kir got their shields ready for battle.

es.L: Y Elam tomó [la] aljaba, con carros de hombres [y] jinetes, \q y Quir desnudó [el] escudo.
es.B: Elam se cargó la aljaba, con carros, hombres y jinetes, \q y Quir quitó la funda a su escudo.
es.R: Llegaron soldados de Elam con sus flechas. Traían carros y jinetes. \q Los soldados de Quir prepararon sus escudos para la batalla.

fr.L: Et Élam a pris le carquois, avec des chars d’hommes [et] des cavaliers, \q et Qir a mis à nu le bouclier.
fr.B: Élam a chargé son carquois, avec des chars, des hommes et des cavaliers, \q et Qir a ôté la housse de son bouclier.
fr.R: Les soldats d’Élam sont venus avec leurs flèches. Ils avaient des chars et des cavaliers. \q Les soldats de Qir ont préparé leurs boucliers pour la bataille.

sw.L: Naye Elamu akalichukua podo, pamoja na magari ya vita ya watu [na] wapanda farasi, \q naye Kiri akaifunua ngao.
sw.B: Elamu alijitwika podo lake, pamoja na magari ya vita, watu na wapanda farasi, \q naye Kiri akaondoa kifuniko cha ngao yake.
sw.R: Askari kutoka Elamu walikuja na mishale yao. Walikuwa na magari ya vita na wapanda farasi. \q Askari kutoka Kiri waliweka tayari ngao zao kwa vita.

vi.L: Và Ê-lam đã mang ống tên, với xe chiến mã của người [và] kỵ binh, \q và Ki-rơ đã để trần cái khiên.
vi.B: Ê-lam đeo ống tên trên vai, có xe chiến mã, bộ binh và kỵ binh, \q còn Ki-rơ tháo bao khỏi khiên.
vi.R: Quân lính từ Ê-lam đến, mang theo cung tên. Họ có xe chiến mã và kỵ binh. \q Quân lính từ Ki-rơ chuẩn bị khiên sẵn sàng ra trận.

decisions.choice: Elam and Kir: peoples far to the east, serving in the attacking army
decisions.reason: Elam lay east of Babylonia; Kir is the place to which Assyria exiled the people of Damascus (2 Kings 16:9; Amos 1:5). Both supplied soldiers to the empires of Assyria and Babylon.

decisions.choice: chariots of men, horsemen: chariots with their crews and riders
decisions.reason: The phrase is compressed and may mean chariots manned by soldiers, together with cavalry.

decisions.choice: laid bare the shield: took off the shield's cover for battle
decisions.reason: Shields were kept in leather covers and uncovered before fighting.

decisions.choice: Soldiers from Elam / Soldiers from Kir
decisions.reason: Readable says that the place names stand for the soldiers they sent.

source.text: וַיְהִ֥י מִבְחַר־עֲמָקַ֖יִךְ מָ֣לְאוּ רָ֑כֶב וְהַפָּ֣רָשִׁ֔ים שֹׁ֖ת שָׁ֥תוּ הַשָּֽׁעְרָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, the choicest of your valleys were full of chariotry, and the horsemen took a firm stand at the gate.

en.L: And it was [that] your choicest valleys were full of chariots, \q and the horsemen set themselves in position at the gate.
en.B: Your finest valleys were filled with chariots, \q and horsemen took up their stations at the gates.
en.R: The best valleys around your city were full of enemy chariots. \q Horsemen took their places at the city gates.

es.L: Y sucedió [que] tus valles más escogidos se llenaron de carros, \q y los jinetes se apostaron firmes a la puerta.
es.B: Tus mejores valles se llenaron de carros, \q y los jinetes tomaron posiciones ante las puertas.
es.R: Los mejores valles alrededor de tu ciudad se llenaron de carros enemigos. \q Los jinetes ocuparon sus puestos junto a las puertas de la ciudad.

fr.L: Et il est arrivé [que] tes meilleures vallées ont été pleines de chars, \q et les cavaliers ont pris position à la porte.
fr.B: Tes plus belles vallées se sont remplies de chars, \q et les cavaliers ont pris position aux portes.
fr.R: Les meilleures vallées autour de votre ville étaient pleines de chars ennemis. \q Des cavaliers ont pris place aux portes de la ville.

sw.L: Ikawa mabonde yako bora yalijaa magari ya vita, \q na wapanda farasi wakajipanga langoni.
sw.B: Mabonde yako mazuri kuliko yote yalijaa magari ya vita, \q na wapanda farasi walishika nafasi zao malangoni.
sw.R: Mabonde mazuri kuliko yote yanayouzunguka mji wako yalijaa magari ya vita ya adui. \q Wapanda farasi walichukua nafasi zao kwenye malango ya mji.

vi.L: Và đã xảy ra [rằng] những thung lũng tốt nhất của ngươi đầy những xe chiến mã, \q và các kỵ binh dàn trận tại cổng thành.
vi.B: Những thung lũng đẹp nhất của ngươi đầy xe chiến mã, \q và kỵ binh dàn thế trận tại các cổng thành.
vi.R: Những thung lũng tốt nhất quanh thành ngươi đầy xe chiến mã của quân thù. \q Kỵ binh đứng sẵn tại các cổng thành.

decisions.choice: and it was: the prophet describes what he sees as already done
decisions.reason: The verbs of verses 7-8 are past forms. The prophet sees the coming attack as if it has happened, as visions often present the future.

decisions.choice: took a firm stand: set themselves in battle position
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled for emphasis. The cavalry is ready at the city gate.

decisions.choice: around your city / enemy chariots
decisions.reason: Readable says whose valleys and whose chariots.

source.text: וַיְגַ֕ל אֵ֖ת מָסַ֣ךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַתַּבֵּט֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא אֶל־נֶ֖שֶׁק בֵּ֥ית הַיָּֽעַר׃

records.literal_gloss: And he uncovered the covering of Judah, and you looked in that day to [the] weaponry of [the] house of the forest.

en.L: And [one] removed the covering of Judah, \q and you looked in that day to the weapons of the house of the forest.
en.B: Judah's covering was torn off, \q and on that day you turned your eyes to the weapons in the House of the Forest.
en.R: Judah was left without protection. \q At that time you looked to the weapons stored in the House of the Forest.

es.L: Y [alguien] quitó la cubierta de Judá, \q y miraste en aquel día hacia las armas de la casa del bosque.
es.B: La cubierta de Judá fue arrancada, \q y aquel día volviste los ojos a las armas de la Casa del Bosque.
es.R: Judá quedó sin protección. \q En ese tiempo pusiste tu confianza en las armas guardadas en la Casa del Bosque.

fr.L: Et [on] a ôté la couverture de Juda, \q et tu as regardé en ce jour-là vers les armes de la maison de la Forêt.
fr.B: La protection de Juda a été arrachée, \q et ce jour-là tu as tourné les yeux vers les armes de la Maison de la Forêt.
fr.R: Juda s’est retrouvé sans protection. \q Ce jour-là, vous avez compté sur les armes rangées dans la Maison de la Forêt.

sw.L: Naye akakiondoa kifuniko cha Yuda, \q nawe ukatazama katika siku ile silaha za nyumba ya msitu.
sw.B: Kifuniko cha Yuda kiliondolewa, \q nawe siku hiyo ukaelekeza macho yako kwenye silaha zilizokuwa katika Nyumba ya Msitu.
sw.R: Yuda iliachwa bila ulinzi. \q Wakati huo ulitegemea silaha zilizohifadhiwa katika Nyumba ya Msitu.

vi.L: Và [người ta] đã lột bỏ tấm che của Giu-đa, \q và trong ngày ấy ngươi đã nhìn đến khí giới của cung Rừng.
vi.B: Tấm che chở của Giu-đa đã bị lột bỏ, \q và vào ngày ấy ngươi đã trông cậy vào khí giới trong Cung Rừng.
vi.R: Giu-đa bị bỏ mặc, không còn gì che chở. \q Vào lúc ấy ngươi trông cậy vào khí giới cất trong Cung Rừng.

decisions.choice: he uncovered: the subject is not named
decisions.reason: The verb has no stated subject. It may be the enemy, or God, who exposes Judah's weakness. The sentence is read here as describing what happened without naming who did it.

decisions.choice: the covering of Judah: Judah's protection
decisions.reason: The covering may be the fortresses that shielded Judah, or the veil that kept its leaders from seeing the danger.

decisions.choice: the house of the forest: Solomon's armory
decisions.reason: Solomon's House of the Forest of Lebanon was built with rows of cedar pillars, and shields of gold were kept in it (1 Kings 7:2; 10:17).

decisions.choice: was torn off / was left without protection
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use a passive, which keeps the subject unnamed as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: en aquel día (L); aquel día (B); en ese tiempo (R)
decisions.reason: The block's forms of "in that day", as published from Joshua to Chronicles.

decisions.choice: "katika siku ile" (L); "siku hiyo" (B); "wakati huo" (R)
decisions.reason: "In that day" is worded this way at each level throughout Isaiah 21-40, as the terms note settles; Readable follows the English "at that time".

decisions.choice: "la maison de la Forêt" (L), "la Maison de la Forêt" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The name of Solomon's hall, as the published "Maison de la Forêt du Liban" (1 Kings 7:2); the shorter Hebrew name is kept.

decisions.choice: "en ce jour-là" (L), "ce jour-là" (B, R), for Isaiah 21-40
decisions.reason: As the terms note; Readable keeps "ce jour-là" where a single day is in view and "en ce temps-là" where the English Readable says "at that time" of a coming age.

decisions.choice: "Cung Rừng" (B, R); "cung Rừng" (L)
decisions.reason: Solomon's House of the Forest of Lebanon was a royal hall; "cung" says it was a palace building, and Balanced and Readable capitalise it as a name, as the English does.

source.text: וְאֵ֨ת בְּקִיעֵ֧י עִיר־דָּוִ֛ד רְאִיתֶ֖ם כִּי־רָ֑בּוּ וַֽתְּקַבְּצ֔וּ אֶת־מֵ֥י הַבְּרֵכָ֖ה הַתַּחְתּוֹנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And the breaches of [the] city of David you saw, that they were many, and you gathered the waters of the lower pool.

en.L: And the breaches of the city of David you saw, that they were many, \q and you collected the waters of the lower pool.
en.B: You saw how many breaches there were in the city of David, \q and you gathered in the water of the lower pool.
en.R: You saw that the walls of the city of David had many gaps. \q You stored up water from the lower pool.

es.L: Y las brechas de la ciudad de David {{plural_you:vieron|visteis}}, que eran muchas, \q y {{plural_you:recogieron|recogisteis}} las aguas del estanque de abajo.
es.B: {{plural_you:Vieron|Visteis}} cuántas brechas había en la ciudad de David, \q y {{plural_you:juntaron|juntasteis}} el agua del estanque de abajo.
es.R: {{plural_you:Vieron|Visteis}} que las murallas de la ciudad de David tenían muchas grietas. \q {{plural_you:Guardaron|Guardasteis}} agua del estanque de abajo.

fr.L: Et les brèches de la cité de David, vous les avez vues, qu’elles étaient nombreuses, \q et vous avez recueilli les eaux de l’étang inférieur.
fr.B: Vous avez vu combien les brèches de la cité de David étaient nombreuses, \q et vous avez amassé les eaux de l’étang inférieur.
fr.R: Vous avez vu que les murailles de la cité de David avaient beaucoup de trous. \q Vous avez mis en réserve l’eau de l’étang d’en bas.

sw.L: Na mavunjiko ya mji wa Daudi mliyaona, kwamba yalikuwa mengi, \q nanyi mkayakusanya maji ya bwawa la chini.
sw.B: Mliona jinsi mapengo yalivyokuwa mengi katika mji wa Daudi, \q mkayakusanya maji ya bwawa la chini.
sw.R: Mliona kwamba kuta za mji wa Daudi zilikuwa na mapengo mengi. \q Mlihifadhi maji kutoka bwawa la chini.

vi.L: Và các chỗ nứt vỡ của thành Đa-vít, các ngươi đã thấy rằng chúng nhiều, \q và các ngươi đã gom nước của hồ dưới.
vi.B: Các ngươi đã thấy thành Đa-vít có biết bao chỗ tường bị nứt vỡ, \q và các ngươi đã gom nước của hồ dưới.
vi.R: Các ngươi thấy tường thành Đa-vít có nhiều chỗ bị vỡ. \q Các ngươi trữ nước lấy từ hồ dưới.

decisions.choice: you gathered the waters of the lower pool: Hezekiah's preparation for siege
decisions.reason: Hezekiah stopped up the springs outside the city and brought water inside by a tunnel (2 Kings 20:20; 2 Chronicles 32:3-4, 30). Verses 9-11 list the defenses made ready against Assyria in 701 BC.

decisions.choice: the city of David: the old citadel of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The name was first given to the stronghold of Zion that David captured (2 Samuel 5:7, 9).

decisions.choice: vieron / visteis
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns here from the city (feminine singular) to the people (masculine plural), so the verbs of verses 9-14 take plural_you.

decisions.choice: "l'étang inférieur", "l'ancien étang" for the pools (berekhah)
decisions.reason: "Piscine" now means a swimming pool; "étang" is a pool of standing water, and "réservoir" is kept for the basin (miqwah) the people built.

source.text: וְאֶת־בָּתֵּ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם סְפַרְתֶּ֑ם וַתִּתְֿצוּ֙ הַבָּ֣תִּ֔ים לְבַצֵּ֖ר הַחוֹמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And the houses of Jerusalem you counted, and you pulled down the houses to fortify the wall.

en.L: And the houses of Jerusalem you counted, \q and you pulled down the houses to fortify the wall.
en.B: You numbered the houses of Jerusalem \q and broke some of them down to make the wall stronger.
en.R: You counted the houses in Jerusalem. \q Then you tore some of them down and used the stones to make the city wall stronger.

es.L: Y las casas de Jerusalén {{plural_you:contaron|contasteis}}, \q y {{plural_you:derribaron|derribasteis}} las casas para fortificar el muro.
es.B: {{plural_you:Contaron|Contasteis}} las casas de Jerusalén \q y {{plural_you:derribaron|derribasteis}} algunas para reforzar la muralla.
es.R: {{plural_you:Contaron|Contasteis}} las casas de Jerusalén. \q Luego {{plural_you:derribaron|derribasteis}} algunas y {{plural_you:usaron|usasteis}} sus piedras para reforzar la muralla de la ciudad.

fr.L: Et les maisons de Jérusalem, vous les avez comptées, \q et vous avez démoli les maisons pour fortifier la muraille.
fr.B: Vous avez fait le compte des maisons de Jérusalem \q et vous en avez abattu pour renforcer la muraille.
fr.R: Vous avez compté les maisons de Jérusalem. \q Puis vous en avez démoli quelques-unes et vous avez pris leurs pierres pour rendre la muraille plus solide.

sw.L: Na nyumba za Yerusalemu mlizihesabu, \q nanyi mkazibomoa nyumba ili kuuimarisha ukuta.
sw.B: Mlizihesabu nyumba za Yerusalemu, \q mkabomoa baadhi yake ili kuuimarisha ukuta.
sw.R: Mlihesabu nyumba za Yerusalemu. \q Kisha mkabomoa baadhi yake, mkatumia mawe yake kuuimarisha ukuta wa mji.

vi.L: Và các nhà của Giê-ru-sa-lem các ngươi đã đếm, \q và các ngươi đã phá đổ các nhà để làm kiên cố tường thành.
vi.B: Các ngươi kiểm đếm nhà cửa trong Giê-ru-sa-lem \q và phá đổ một số nhà để gia cố tường thành.
vi.R: Các ngươi đếm nhà cửa trong Giê-ru-sa-lem. \q Rồi các ngươi phá bớt một số nhà và lấy đá để làm tường thành vững chắc hơn.

decisions.choice: counted the houses ... pulled down the houses: stones taken for the wall
decisions.reason: Houses were surveyed and some demolished to supply stone for repairing and thickening the wall (2 Chronicles 32:5). Remains of a thick wall from Hezekiah's time, built across older houses, have been found in Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: used the stones
decisions.reason: Readable says how pulling down houses strengthened the wall.

source.text: וּמִקְוָ֣ה׀עֲשִׂיתֶ֗ם בֵּ֚ין הַחֹ֣מֹתַ֔יִם לְמֵ֖י הַבְּרֵכָ֣ה הַיְשָׁנָ֑ה וְלֹ֤א הִבַּטְתֶּם֙ אֶל־עֹשֶׂ֔יהָ וְיֹצְרָ֥הּ מֵֽרָח֖וֹק לֹ֥א רְאִיתֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And a reservoir you made between the two walls for [the] waters of the old pool, and not you looked to [the one who] made it, and [the one who] formed it from long ago not you saw.

en.L: And a reservoir you made between the two walls \q for the waters of the old pool, \q but you did not look to [the one who] made it, \q and [the one who] formed it long ago you did not see.
en.B: Between the two walls you made a basin to hold the water of the old pool. \q But you never looked to its maker, \q or paid heed to the one who formed it long ago.
en.R: You built a pool between the two walls to hold water from the old pool. \q But you did not turn to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who made all this happen. \q You paid no attention to the one who had it in mind long ago.

es.L: Y un depósito {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} entre los dos muros \q para las aguas del estanque viejo, \q pero no {{plural_you:miraron|mirasteis}} a [quien] lo hizo, \q y a [quien] lo formó desde hace mucho no {{plural_you:vieron|visteis}}.
es.B: Entre los dos muros {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} un estanque para recoger el agua del estanque viejo. \q Pero nunca {{plural_you:volvieron|volvisteis}} los ojos a quien lo hizo, \q ni {{plural_you:tuvieron|tuvisteis}} en cuenta a quien lo formó hace mucho tiempo.
es.R: {{plural_you:Construyeron|Construisteis}} un estanque entre las dos murallas para guardar el agua del estanque viejo. \q Pero no {{plural_you:buscaron|buscasteis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, que hizo que todo esto sucediera. \q No {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} caso de aquel que lo había planeado desde hace mucho.

fr.L: Et vous avez fait un réservoir entre les deux murailles \q pour les eaux de l’ancien étang, \q mais vous n’avez pas regardé vers [celui qui] l’a fait, \q et [celui qui] l’a formé depuis longtemps, vous ne l’avez pas vu.
fr.B: Entre les deux murailles, vous avez creusé un bassin pour garder l’eau de l’ancien étang. \q Mais vous n’avez jamais tourné les yeux vers celui qui en est l’auteur, \q et vous n’avez prêté aucune attention à celui qui l’a formé il y a longtemps.
fr.R: Vous avez construit un bassin entre les deux murailles, pour garder l’eau de l’ancien étang. \q Mais vous ne vous êtes pas tournés vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui a fait arriver tout cela. \q Vous n’avez fait aucune attention à celui qui l’avait prévu depuis longtemps.

sw.L: Nanyi mlitengeneza birika kati ya kuta mbili \q kwa ajili ya maji ya bwawa la zamani, \q lakini hamkumtazama aliyelifanya, \q wala aliyeliumba tangu zamani hamkumwona.
sw.B: Kati ya kuta mbili mlitengeneza birika la kuhifadhi maji ya bwawa la zamani. \q Lakini hamkumtazama kamwe yeye aliyelifanya, \q wala hamkumjali yeye aliyelipanga tangu zamani.
sw.R: Mlijenga bwawa kati ya kuta mbili ili kuhifadhi maji kutoka bwawa la zamani. \q Lakini hamkumgeukia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliyefanya mambo haya yote yatokee. \q Hamkumjali yeye aliyekuwa ameyapanga tangu zamani.

vi.L: Và một bể chứa các ngươi đã làm giữa hai tường thành \q cho nước của hồ cũ, \q nhưng các ngươi đã không nhìn đến [Đấng] đã làm nên nó, \q và [Đấng] đã hình thành nó từ xưa các ngươi đã không thấy.
vi.B: Các ngươi xây một bể chứa giữa hai bức tường để giữ nước của hồ cũ. \q Nhưng các ngươi chẳng hề nhìn đến Đấng làm nên nó, \q cũng chẳng đoái đến Đấng đã hình thành nó từ lâu.
vi.R: Các ngươi xây một hồ chứa nước giữa hai bức tường để trữ nước từ hồ cũ. \q Nhưng các ngươi không hướng về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là Đấng đã làm cho mọi việc này xảy ra. \q Các ngươi không quan tâm đến Đấng đã định sẵn điều ấy từ lâu.

decisions.choice: you did not look to the one who made it: they trusted their defenses, not God
decisions.reason: "Looked" repeats the verb of verse 8: the people looked to weapons and water works but not to God. "Made" and "formed" are God's work, the same pair as in 37:26 (2 Kings 19:25), where God says he planned long ago what he now brings about.

decisions.choice: made it ... formed it: the city's coming disaster, or the city itself
alternatives: the one who made the pool
decisions.reason: The pronoun "it" is feminine. It may refer to the city and its water, which God made, or to the whole event God planned. Either way the one meant is God.

decisions.choice: the LORD, who made all this happen
decisions.reason: Readable names God, the one meant by "the one who made it", and follows the reading that "it" is the coming event.

decisions.choice: "Đấng" for "the one who made it"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says the maker and former is God, so Vietnamese uses the honorific "Đấng"; it carries no deity_pronoun span, since it is a noun, not a free pronoun.

source.text: וַיִּקְרָ֗א אֲדֹנָ֧י יְהוִ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא לִבְכִי֙ וּלְמִסְפֵּ֔ד וּלְקָרְחָ֖ה וְלַחֲגֹ֥ר שָֽׂק׃

records.literal_gloss: And called [the] Lord Yahweh of hosts in that day for weeping and for mourning and for baldness and for girding [with] sackcloth.

en.L: And the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of hosts called in that day \q for weeping and for mourning \q and for baldness and for putting on sackcloth.
en.B: On that day the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies called \q for weeping and lament, \q for shaved heads and for the wearing of sackcloth.
en.R: At that time the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies called {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people to cry and mourn. \q He told them to shave their heads and wear rough clothes made of sackcloth.

es.L: Y el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos llamó en aquel día \q al llanto y al lamento, \q y a la calvicie y a ceñirse de cilicio.
es.B: Aquel día el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos llamó \q al llanto y al lamento, \q a raparse la cabeza y a vestirse de cilicio.
es.R: En ese tiempo el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos llamó a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo a llorar y a hacer duelo. \q Les dijo que se raparan la cabeza y se vistieran con ropa áspera de luto.

fr.L: Et le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées a appelé en ce jour-là \q aux pleurs et au deuil, \q à la tête rasée et à l’habit de sac.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées a appelé \q à pleurer et à se lamenter, \q à se raser la tête et à revêtir le sac.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées a appelé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple à pleurer et à prendre le deuil. \q Il leur a dit de se raser la tête et de porter des vêtements de toile de sac.

sw.L: Naye Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi akaita katika siku ile \q kwa ajili ya kulia na kuomboleza \q na kwa ajili ya upara na kujifunga magunia.
sw.B: Siku hiyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi aliita \q watu walie na kuomboleza, \q wanyoe vichwa vyao na kuvaa magunia.
sw.R: Wakati huo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi aliwaita watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} walie na kuomboleza. \q Aliwaambia wanyoe vichwa vyao na kuvaa nguo za magunia.

vi.L: Và trong ngày ấy, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã kêu gọi \q khóc lóc và than van, \q cạo đầu và thắt lưng bằng vải thô.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã kêu gọi \q hãy khóc lóc và than van, \q hãy cạo đầu và mặc áo vải thô.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân kêu gọi dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khóc lóc và than van. \q Ngài bảo họ cạo đầu và mặc áo vải thô.

decisions.choice: baldness ... sackcloth: signs of mourning and repentance
decisions.reason: People shaved their heads and wore rough sackcloth to grieve and to turn back to God (15:2-3; Joel 1:13; Micah 1:16).

decisions.choice: called for weeping: God summoned them to repent
decisions.reason: The danger was a call to humble themselves before God. Their answer is the feast of verse 13.

decisions.choice: called his people / He told them
decisions.reason: Readable says whom God called.

decisions.choice: cilicio
decisions.reason: "Cilicio" is the Spanish word for the coarse cloth of mourning; Readable says "ropa áspera de luto", as the English R explains it.

decisions.choice: "vải thô" (every level)
decisions.reason: Sackcloth is a coarse cloth worn in mourning; "vải thô" names the cloth plainly and is the published word (2 Kings 19:1-2, which Isaiah 37:1-2 repeats). It is used for sackcloth at every level across Isaiah and Jeremiah.

source.text: וְהִנֵּ֣ה׀שָׂשׂ֣וֹן וְשִׂמְחָ֗ה הָרֹ֤ג׀בָּקָר֙ וְשָׁחֹ֣ט צֹ֔אן אָכֹ֥ל בָּשָׂ֖ר וְשָׁת֣וֹת יָ֑יִן אָכ֣וֹל וְשָׁת֔וֹ כִּ֥י מָחָ֖ר נָמֽוּת׃

records.literal_gloss: And look, joy and gladness, killing cattle and slaughtering sheep, eating meat and drinking wine: eating and drinking, for tomorrow we will die.

en.L: But look, joy and gladness, slaying cattle and butchering sheep, \q eating meat and drinking wine: \q "Eat and drink, for tomorrow we die!"
en.B: Instead, there was feasting and merriment, cattle killed and sheep butchered, \q meat eaten and wine poured. \q "Let us eat and drink," you said, "because tomorrow we will die!"
en.R: Instead, you laughed and celebrated. You killed cattle and sheep for feasts. \q You ate meat and drank wine. \q You said, "Let us eat and drink now, because tomorrow we will die!"

es.L: Pero he aquí gozo y alegría, matar bueyes y degollar ovejas, \q comer carne y beber vino: \q «¡Comamos y bebamos, que mañana moriremos!».
es.B: En cambio, hubo fiesta y regocijo, se mataron bueyes y se degollaron ovejas, \q se comió carne y se sirvió vino. \q «Comamos y bebamos —{{plural_you:decían|decíais}}—, que mañana moriremos».
es.R: En cambio, {{plural_you:ustedes se rieron y celebraron|vosotros os reísteis y celebrasteis}}. {{plural_you:Mataron|Matasteis}} bueyes y ovejas para hacer banquetes. \q {{plural_you:Comieron|Comisteis}} carne y {{plural_you:bebieron|bebisteis}} vino. \q {{plural_you:Decían|Decíais}}: «¡Comamos y bebamos ahora, porque mañana moriremos!».

fr.L: Mais voici, la joie et l’allégresse, on tue des bœufs et on égorge des moutons, \q on mange de la viande et on boit du vin : \q « Mangeons et buvons, car demain nous mourrons ! »
fr.B: Au lieu de cela, c’est la fête et la gaieté : on abat des bœufs, on égorge des moutons, \q on mange de la viande, on verse le vin. \q « Mangeons et buvons, disiez-vous, car demain nous mourrons ! »
fr.R: Au contraire, vous avez ri et fait la fête. Vous avez tué des bœufs et des moutons pour vos festins. \q Vous avez mangé de la viande et bu du vin. \q Vous disiez : « Mangeons et buvons maintenant, car demain nous mourrons ! »

sw.L: Lakini tazama, furaha na shangwe, kuchinja ng'ombe na kuchinja kondoo, \q kula nyama na kunywa divai: \q "Tule na tunywe, kwa maana kesho tunakufa!"
sw.B: Badala yake, kulikuwa na karamu na shangwe, ng'ombe wakichinjwa na kondoo wakichinjwa, \q nyama ikiliwa na divai ikinywewa. \q Mlisema, "Tule na tunywe, kwa sababu kesho tutakufa!"
sw.R: Badala yake, mlicheka na kusherehekea. Mlichinja ng'ombe na kondoo kwa ajili ya karamu. \q Mlikula nyama na kunywa divai. \q Mlisema, "Tule na tunywe sasa, kwa sababu kesho tutakufa!"

vi.L: Nhưng kìa, vui vẻ và hân hoan, giết bò và làm thịt chiên, \q ăn thịt và uống rượu: \q "Hãy ăn và uống, vì ngày mai chúng ta chết!"
vi.B: Thay vào đó lại có tiệc tùng vui vẻ, bò bị giết và chiên bị làm thịt, \q thịt được ăn và rượu được rót. \q Các ngươi nói: "Hãy ăn uống đi, vì ngày mai chúng ta sẽ chết!"
vi.R: Thay vào đó, các ngươi cười đùa và tiệc tùng. Các ngươi giết bò và chiên để ăn tiệc. \q Các ngươi ăn thịt và uống rượu. \q Các ngươi nói: "Hãy ăn uống bây giờ đi, vì ngày mai chúng ta sẽ chết!"

decisions.choice: killing ... eating ... drinking: a string of verbs without subjects
decisions.reason: The verbs are infinitives, which make a quick picture of a feast. The last pair is the people's own saying.

decisions.choice: let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die: quoted by Paul
decisions.reason: Paul quotes these words in 1 Corinthians 15:32 as the outlook of people who have no hope of resurrection.

decisions.choice: you said
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable mark the last words as the people's own saying.

decisions.choice: "Tule na tunywe, kwa maana kesho tunakufa" (L)
decisions.reason: Paul quotes these words in 1 Corinthians 15:32, and the published Swahili there has "Na tule na tunywe, kwa maana kesho tunakufa"; the same key words are kept so a reader can see the quotation.

decisions.choice: "Mangeons et buvons, car demain nous mourrons" at every level
alternatives: "Mangeons et buvons, demain nous serons morts"
decisions.reason: The words Paul quotes in 1 Corinthians 15:32; French keeps the same plain wording so the quotation can be seen.

source.text: וְנִגְלָ֥ה בְאָזְנָ֖י יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת אִם־יְ֠כֻפַּר הֶעָוֺ֨ןהַזֶּ֤ה לָכֶם֙ עַד־תְּמֻת֔וּן אָמַ֛ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And has revealed himself in my ears Yahweh of hosts: surely not will be atoned this iniquity for you until you die, says [the] Lord Yahweh of hosts.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts revealed {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} in my ears: \q Surely this iniquity will not be atoned for you until you die, \q says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of hosts.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies has made {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} known to my ears: \q This guilt of yours will never be atoned for until the day you die, \q says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies spoke to me clearly. \q The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: \q This sin of yours will never be forgiven as long as you live.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos se reveló a mis oídos: \q Ciertamente esta iniquidad no {{plural_you:les será expiada hasta que mueran|os será expiada hasta que muráis}}, \q dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos se ha dado a conocer a mis oídos: \q Esta culpa {{plural_you:suya|vuestra}} nunca será expiada hasta el día en que {{plural_you:mueran|muráis}}, \q dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos me habló claramente. \q El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice: \q Este pecado {{plural_you:suyo|vuestro}} nunca será perdonado mientras {{plural_you:vivan|viváis}}.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées s’est révélé à mes oreilles : \q Certainement cette iniquité ne sera pas expiée pour vous jusqu’à ce que vous mouriez, \q dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées s’est fait entendre à mes oreilles : \q Jamais cette faute ne vous sera pardonnée, jusqu’au jour de votre mort, \q dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées m’a parlé clairement. \q Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées dit : \q Ce péché ne vous sera jamais pardonné, tant que vous vivrez.

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi amejifunua masikioni mwangu: \q Hakika uovu huu hautafanyiwa upatanisho kwa ajili yenu mpaka mfe, \q asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi amejifunua masikioni mwangu: \q Hatia yenu hii haitafanyiwa upatanisho kamwe mpaka siku mtakapokufa, \q asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi alinieleza waziwazi. \q Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi anasema: \q Dhambi yenu hii haitasamehewa kamwe maadamu mko hai.

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã tỏ mình ra trong tai tôi: \q Chắc chắn tội ác này sẽ không được chuộc cho các ngươi cho đến khi các ngươi chết, \q Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã tỏ cho tai tôi nghe: \q Tội lỗi này của các ngươi sẽ không bao giờ được chuộc cho đến ngày các ngươi chết, \q Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã phán rõ cho tôi nghe. \q Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: \q Tội này của các ngươi sẽ không bao giờ được tha suốt đời các ngươi.

decisions.choice: surely not: a solemn oath
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses the form of an oath with the curse left unsaid ("if it will be atoned for ..."), which means "it will certainly not".

decisions.choice: atoned for: covered, wiped away
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for atonement (6:7). This sin of refusing to repent will not be removed while they live.

decisions.choice: until you die: for the rest of your lives
decisions.reason: The phrase answers the people's "tomorrow we will die" in verse 13. It does not say what happens after death.

decisions.choice: will never be forgiven as long as you live
decisions.reason: Readable says what "not be atoned for until you die" means.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span on "amejifunua"
decisions.reason: The English "himself" has a span, but Swahili says "revealed himself" with the reflexive "-ji-" inside the verb, which cannot take a capital; as throughout Swahili, spans go only on free pronouns, so this block has fewer spans than the English.

decisions.choice: "được chuộc"
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for atonement; Literal and Balanced keep "chuộc", and Readable says what it means, "được tha", as the English Readable says "forgiven".

decisions.choice: "tỏ mình ra" with no span
decisions.reason: The English spans "Himself"; Vietnamese uses the reflexive "mình", which is not a pronoun for God alone, so it takes no deity_pronoun span.

source.text: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה צְבָא֑וֹת לֶךְ־בֹּא֙ אֶל־הַסֹּכֵ֣ן הַזֶּ֔ה עַל־שֶׁבְנָ֖א אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־הַבָּֽיִת׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says [the] Lord Yahweh of hosts: come, go to this steward, to Shebna, who [is] over the house:

en.L: Thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of hosts: \q "Come, go to this steward, \q to Shebna, who [is] over the house, [and say,]
en.B: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: \q "Go to this steward, \q to Shebna, who is in charge of the palace, and say to him,
en.R: This is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: \q "Go to that official Shebna, the man in charge of the king's palace. Tell him,

es.L: Así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos: \q «Ven, ve a este mayordomo, \q a Sebna, que [está] sobre la casa, [y dile:]
es.B: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto: \q «Ve a este mayordomo, \q a Sebna, que está a cargo del palacio, y dile:
es.R: Esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: \q «Ve a ver a ese funcionario, Sebna, el que está a cargo del palacio del rey. Dile:

fr.L: Ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées : \q « Va, rends-toi chez cet intendant, \q chez Shebna, qui [est] au-dessus de la maison, [et dis-lui :]
fr.B: Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci : \q « Va trouver cet intendant, \q Shebna, le chef du palais, et dis-lui :
fr.R: Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées : \q « Va voir ce Shebna, l’homme qui dirige le palais du roi. Dis-lui :

sw.L: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi: \q "Njoo, nenda kwa wakili huyu, \q kwa Shebna, aliye juu ya nyumba, [umwambie,]
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asemavyo: \q "Nenda kwa wakili huyu, \q kwa Shebna, aliye msimamizi wa ikulu, umwambie,
sw.R: Hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analosema: \q "Nenda kwa yule afisa Shebna, mtu anayesimamia ikulu ya mfalme. Mwambie,

vi.L: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: \q "Hãy đi, đến cùng người quản lý này, \q đến cùng Sép-na, [là người] cai quản cung điện, [và nói:]
vi.B: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán như vầy: \q "Hãy đi đến với viên quản lý này, \q đến với Sép-na, quan cai quản cung điện, và nói với hắn:
vi.R: Đây là lời Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: \q "Hãy đi đến gặp viên quan Sép-na, người cai quản cung điện của vua. Hãy nói với hắn:

decisions.choice: steward ... over the house: the chief official of the royal palace
decisions.reason: The man "over the house" managed the king's household and spoke for him (1 Kings 4:6; 2 Kings 15:5). In 36:3 and 2 Kings 18:18 Eliakim holds that office and Shebna is secretary, which suggests the change foretold here took place.

decisions.choice: this steward: said with contempt
decisions.reason: "This" points at Shebna with scorn, as the questions in verse 16 do. Shebna's father is not named, unlike Eliakim's (verse 20).

decisions.choice: and say
decisions.reason: The Hebrew moves straight into the message of verse 16; the words that introduce it are supplied.

decisions.choice: Así dice (L); dice esto (B); Esto es lo que dice (R)
decisions.reason: The block's forms of "Thus says the LORD", as the Kings-Chronicles note, each followed by a colon.

decisions.choice: "X asema hivi:" (L); "Hivi ndivyo X asemavyo:" (B); "Hili ndilo X analosema:" (R)
decisions.reason: "Thus says the LORD" keeps the wording of 2 Kings 19:6 and 1 Chronicles 17:4 at each level throughout this block, as the terms note settles.

decisions.choice: "wakili"
decisions.reason: "Steward" is "wakili", the household manager of Luke 16:1, so that "msimamizi wa ikulu" (2 Kings 18:18) stays free for "over the house".

decisions.choice: "Ainsi parle ... :" (L), "... dit ceci :" (B), "Voici ce que dit ... :" (R), for Isaiah 21-40
decisions.reason: As the terms note and 2 Kings 19:6; 20:1.

decisions.choice: "cai quản cung điện"
decisions.reason: The chief palace official, as 2 Kings 18:18 names Eliakim's office ("quan cai quản cung điện"); the same title is used for both men.

decisions.choice: "hắn" for Shebna
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says Shebna is pointed out with contempt; "hắn" carries that tone, against the respectful "ông" used for Eliakim.

source.text: מַה־לְּךָ֥ פֹה֙ וּמִ֣י לְךָ֣ פֹ֔ה כִּֽי־חָצַ֧בְתָּ לְּךָ֛ פֹּ֖ה קָ֑בֶר חֹצְבִ֤י מָרוֹם֙ קִבְר֔וֹ חֹקְקִ֥י בַסֶּ֖לַע מִשְׁכָּ֥ן לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: What [is] to you here, and who [is] to you here, that you have cut out for yourself here a tomb? Cutting out on high his tomb, carving in the rock a dwelling for himself!

en.L: 'What [is] yours here, and whom [have] you here, \q that you have cut out a tomb for yourself here, \q cutting out his tomb on the height, \q carving a dwelling for himself in the rock?
en.B: 'What right do you have here, and who are your relatives here, \q that you have hewn a tomb for yourself here? \q He carves his grave high on the hill \q and hollows out a home for himself in the rock!
en.R: 'What is yours here? \q Who said you could carve out a tomb for yourself in this place? \q You have made a fine tomb high up on the hill. \q You have carved a place for yourself in the rock to lie in when you die.

es.L: “¿Qué [tienes] tú aquí, y a quién [tienes] aquí, \q para que te hayas labrado aquí un sepulcro, \q labrando en lo alto su sepulcro, \q tallando en la roca una morada para sí?
es.B: “¿Qué derecho tienes aquí, y qué parientes tienes aquí, \q para haberte cavado aquí un sepulcro? \q ¡Se labra su tumba en lo alto del cerro \q y se excava en la roca una morada!
es.R: “¿Qué tienes tú aquí? \q ¿Quién te dio permiso para labrarte un sepulcro en este lugar? \q Te has hecho una hermosa tumba en lo alto del cerro. \q Te has excavado en la roca un lugar donde descansar cuando mueras.

fr.L: “Qu’[as]-tu ici, et qui [as]-tu ici, \q pour t’être taillé ici un tombeau, \q lui qui taille son tombeau sur la hauteur, \q qui creuse dans le roc une demeure pour lui-même ?
fr.B: “De quel droit es-tu ici, et quels parents as-tu ici, \q pour t’y être creusé un tombeau ? \q Il taille sa sépulture tout en haut \q et se creuse une demeure dans le roc !
fr.R: “Qu’est-ce qui t’appartient ici ? \q Qui t’a permis de te tailler un tombeau à cet endroit ? \q Tu t’es fait un beau tombeau en haut de la colline. \q Tu t’es creusé une place dans le rocher pour y reposer quand tu mourras.

sw.L: 'Una [nini] hapa, na una [nani] hapa, \q hata umejichongea kaburi hapa, \q akichonga kaburi lake mahali pa juu, \q akijichongea makao mwambani?
sw.B: 'Una haki gani hapa, na una ndugu gani hapa, \q hata umejichongea kaburi hapa? \q Anachonga kaburi lake juu kilimani \q na kujitobolea makao mwambani!
sw.R: 'Una nini hapa? \q Ni nani aliyekuruhusu kujichongea kaburi mahali hapa? \q Umejitengenezea kaburi zuri juu kilimani. \q Umejichongea mahali mwambani pa kulala utakapokufa.

vi.L: 'Ngươi có gì ở đây, và ngươi có ai ở đây, \q mà ngươi đã đục cho mình một mồ mả ở đây, \q đục mồ mả của hắn trên nơi cao, \q khoét cho mình một chỗ ở trong vầng đá?
vi.B: 'Ngươi có quyền gì ở đây, và ngươi có bà con nào ở đây, \q mà ngươi lại đẽo cho mình một ngôi mộ ở đây? \q Hắn đục mộ mình trên đỉnh đồi cao, \q khoét cho mình một chỗ ở trong vầng đá!
vi.R: 'Ngươi có gì ở đây? \q Ai cho phép ngươi đục một ngôi mộ cho mình ở chỗ này? \q Ngươi đã làm một ngôi mộ đẹp trên đỉnh đồi cao. \q Ngươi đã khoét đá làm chỗ cho mình nằm khi chết.

decisions.choice: a tomb ... a dwelling in the rock: a grand rock-cut tomb
decisions.reason: Wealthy families in Jerusalem cut tombs into the rock. Shebna prepares a lasting monument for himself, but verse 18 says he will die in a foreign land.

decisions.choice: what ... who: what claim and what family do you have here
decisions.reason: The questions ask what right Shebna has to a tomb in this place; he may have had no ancestral family there.

decisions.choice: cutting out ... carving: a sudden change to "he"
decisions.reason: The speech turns from "you" to "he", as if the prophet points Shebna out to others.

decisions.choice: You have made ... You have carved
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "you" throughout so the reader does not lose track of the person meant.

source.text: הִנֵּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ מְטַלְטֶלְךָ֔ טַלְטֵלָ֖ה גָּ֑בֶר וְעֹטְךָ֖ עָטֹֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, Yahweh [is] about to hurl you, hurling, O man, and to grasp you firmly.

en.L: Look, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is about to hurl you away, a hurling, O man, \q and to grasp you firmly.
en.B: Look out, you strong man! \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is going to fling you far away \q and grip you hard.
en.R: You think you are such an important man. \q But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is about to grab you and throw you far away.

es.L: He aquí, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está a punto de arrojarte, de arrojarte lejos, oh hombre, \q y de agarrarte con fuerza.
es.B: ¡Cuidado, hombre poderoso! \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} va a lanzarte muy lejos \q y a sujetarte con fuerza.
es.R: Te crees un hombre muy importante. \q Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está a punto de agarrarte y lanzarte muy lejos.

fr.L: Voici, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} va te lancer au loin, d’un lancer, ô homme, \q et te saisir fermement.
fr.B: Prends garde, homme puissant ! \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} va te jeter au loin \q et t’empoigner avec force.
fr.R: Tu te crois un homme si important ! \q Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} va t’attraper et te jeter très loin.

sw.L: Tazama, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anakaribia kukutupa mbali, kutupa kwa nguvu, ee mtu, \q na kukushika kwa nguvu.
sw.B: Jihadhari, wewe mtu mwenye nguvu! \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakutupa mbali sana \q na kukushika kwa nguvu.
sw.R: Unajiona kuwa mtu muhimu sana. \q Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yuko karibu kukukamata na kukutupa mbali sana.

vi.L: Kìa, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sắp quăng ngươi đi, một sự quăng mạnh, hỡi người dũng sĩ, \q và nắm chặt lấy ngươi.
vi.B: Hãy coi chừng, hỡi kẻ mạnh sức kia! \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sắp ném ngươi đi thật xa \q và túm chặt lấy ngươi.
vi.R: Ngươi tưởng mình là người quan trọng lắm. \q Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sắp túm lấy ngươi và ném ngươi thật xa.

decisions.choice: O man: a mighty man, spoken in mockery
decisions.reason: The word means a strong man or warrior. Here it mocks Shebna's self-importance.

decisions.choice: grasp you firmly: seize you tightly
decisions.reason: The verb may instead mean "wrap" or "cover", taking hold of Shebna before winding him up in verse 18.

decisions.choice: You think you are such an important man
decisions.reason: Readable explains the mockery in "O man".

source.text: צָנ֤וֹף יִצְנָפְךָ֙ צְנֵפָ֔ה כַּדּ֕וּר אֶל־אֶ֖רֶץ רַחֲבַ֣ת יָדָ֑יִם שָׁ֣מָּה תָמ֗וּת וְשָׁ֨מָּה֙ מַרְכְּב֣וֹת כְּבוֹדֶ֔ךָ קְל֖וֹן בֵּ֥ית אֲדֹנֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Winding he will wind you [in] a winding, like a ball, to a land broad of both sides; there you will die, and there the chariots of your glory, O disgrace of [the] house of your master.

en.L: He will wind you up tightly, winding [you] like a ball, \q into a land wide on both sides. \q There you will die, and there [will be] the chariots of your glory, \q you disgrace to the house of your master!
en.B: He will wind you round and round and fling you like a ball \q into a broad, open country. \q There you will die, and there your splendid chariots will stay, \q you disgrace to your master's house!
en.R: He will wind you up like a ball and throw you far away into a wide open land. \q There you will die. There your fine chariots will be left. \q You have brought shame on your master, the king.

es.L: Te enrollará bien enrollado, [te arrollará] como una pelota \q hacia una tierra ancha por ambos lados. \q Allí morirás, y allí [quedarán] los carros de tu gloria, \q ¡oh deshonra de la casa de tu señor!
es.B: Te enrollará una y otra vez y te lanzará como una pelota \q a una tierra extensa y abierta. \q Allí morirás, y allí se quedarán tus espléndidos carros, \q ¡tú, deshonra de la casa de tu señor!
es.R: Te enrollará como una pelota y te lanzará lejos, a una tierra ancha y abierta. \q Allí morirás. Allí quedarán tus lujosos carros. \q Has traído vergüenza a tu señor, el rey.

fr.L: Il t’enroulera d’un enroulement serré, comme une balle, \q vers un pays large des deux côtés. \q Là tu mourras, et là [seront] les chars de ta gloire, \q toi, honte de la maison de ton maître !
fr.B: Il te roulera et te roulera encore, et te lancera comme une balle \q dans un pays vaste et ouvert. \q Là tu mourras, et là resteront tes chars splendides, \q toi, la honte de la maison de ton maître !
fr.R: Il va te rouler comme une balle et te jeter loin, dans un pays grand ouvert. \q C’est là que tu mourras. C’est là que tes beaux chars resteront. \q Tu as couvert de honte ton maître, le roi.

sw.L: Atakuviringisha kwa nguvu, kama mpira, \q katika nchi pana pande zote mbili. \q Huko utakufa, na huko [yatakuwa] magari ya utukufu wako, \q wewe aibu ya nyumba ya bwana wako!
sw.B: Atakuviringisha tena na tena na kukutupa kama mpira \q katika nchi pana iliyo wazi. \q Huko utakufa, na huko magari yako ya fahari yatabaki, \q wewe aibu ya nyumba ya bwana wako!
sw.R: Atakuviringisha kama mpira na kukutupa mbali katika nchi pana iliyo wazi. \q Huko utakufa. Huko magari yako mazuri yataachwa. \q Umemletea aibu bwana wako, mfalme.

vi.L: Ngài sẽ cuộn ngươi lại thật chặt, cuộn [ngươi] như quả bóng, \q [ném] vào một xứ rộng cả hai bên. \q Tại đó ngươi sẽ chết, và tại đó [sẽ có] các xe vinh quang của ngươi, \q hỡi kẻ làm nhục nhà chủ ngươi!
vi.B: Ngài sẽ cuộn tròn ngươi lại và ném ngươi như quả bóng \q vào một xứ rộng mênh mông. \q Tại đó ngươi sẽ chết, và tại đó những cỗ xe lộng lẫy của ngươi sẽ nằm lại, \q hỡi kẻ làm nhục nhà chủ mình!
vi.R: Ngài sẽ cuộn ngươi lại như quả bóng và ném ngươi thật xa vào một vùng đất rộng lớn. \q Tại đó ngươi sẽ chết. Những cỗ xe sang trọng của ngươi sẽ bị bỏ lại đó. \q Ngươi đã làm nhục chủ mình là vua.

decisions.choice: a land broad of both sides: a wide, open country
decisions.reason: The phrase pictures a broad plain, like Mesopotamia, where a ball thrown far rolls on and on. Shebna will die in exile.

decisions.choice: the chariots of your glory: your splendid chariots
decisions.reason: The word usually rendered glory here means splendor or honor, the status Shebna displayed in his chariots.

decisions.choice: your master: the king
decisions.reason: The form is plural, a plural of majesty for Shebna's lord, the king of Judah (Hezekiah, 36:1-3).

decisions.choice: splendid chariots / fine chariots
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "glory"; Balanced and Readable say what it means here.

decisions.choice: the king
decisions.reason: Readable names Shebna's master.

decisions.choice: "Ngài" opening a sentence, unspanned
decisions.reason: The pronoun for God here opens the sentence, so it is written plainly with its capital, as the style guide sets; mid-sentence pronouns for God take the span.

source.text: וַהֲדַפְתִּ֖יךָ מִמַּצָּבֶ֑ךָ וּמִמַּעֲמָֽדְךָ֖ יֶהֶרְסֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will push you from your office, and from your position he will tear you down.

en.L: And I will push you from your office, \q and from your position {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will pull you down.
en.B: I will drive you out of your office, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will pull you down from your post.
en.R: I will remove you from your job. \q You will be thrown down from your high position.

es.L: Y te echaré de tu cargo, \q y de tu puesto {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te derribará.
es.B: Te arrojaré de tu cargo, \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te derribará de tu puesto.
es.R: Te quitaré tu trabajo. \q Serás derribado de tu alto puesto.

fr.L: Et je te chasserai de ton poste, \q et de ta position {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te renversera.
fr.B: Je te chasserai de ta charge, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te fera tomber de ton poste.
fr.R: Je vais te retirer ton travail. \q Tu seras jeté à bas de ta haute position.

sw.L: Nami nitakusukuma kutoka katika cheo chako, \q na kutoka katika nafasi yako atakuangusha.
sw.B: Nitakuondoa katika cheo chako, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atakushusha kutoka katika nafasi yako.
sw.R: Nitakuondoa kazini mwako. \q Utatupwa chini kutoka katika cheo chako cha juu.

vi.L: Và Ta sẽ xô ngươi khỏi chức vụ ngươi, \q và từ địa vị ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ kéo ngươi xuống.
vi.B: Ta sẽ đuổi ngươi khỏi chức vụ, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ lật đổ ngươi khỏi địa vị.
vi.R: Ta sẽ cách chức ngươi. \q Ngươi sẽ bị hạ khỏi địa vị cao của mình.

decisions.choice: I ... he: God speaks first of himself, then of himself as "he"
decisions.reason: The change of person is common in prophetic speech. Both verbs have God as their subject.

decisions.choice: office ... position: Shebna's post at court
decisions.reason: The second word means a place where one stands, here a standing at court.

decisions.choice: You will be thrown down
decisions.reason: Readable uses a passive to avoid the confusing change from "I" to "he".

source.text: וְהָיָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וְקָרָ֣אתִי לְעַבְדִּ֔י לְאֶלְיָקִ֖ים בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be in that day, and I will call my servant, Eliakim [the] son of Hilkiah.

en.L: And it will be in that day [that] I will call {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant, Eliakim son of Hilkiah.
en.B: When that day comes, I will call for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah.
en.R: At that time I will call {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah.

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día [que] llamaré a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo, Eliaquim hijo de Hilcías.
es.B: Cuando llegue aquel día, llamaré a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo Eliaquim hijo de Hilcías.
es.R: En ese tiempo llamaré a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo Eliaquim hijo de Hilcías.

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là [que] j’appellerai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, Éliaqim fils de Hilqiya.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, j’appellerai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur Éliaqim fils de Hilqiya.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, j’appellerai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur Éliaqim fils de Hilqiya.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile, nitamwita mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, Eliakimu mwana wa Hilkia.
sw.B: Siku hiyo itakapofika, nitamwita mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Eliakimu mwana wa Hilkia.
sw.R: Wakati huo nitamwita mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Eliakimu mwana wa Hilkia.

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra trong ngày ấy, Ta sẽ gọi đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Ê-li-a-kim con trai Hinh-kia.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, Ta sẽ gọi đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Ê-li-a-kim con trai Hinh-kia.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, Ta sẽ gọi đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Ê-li-a-kim con trai Hinh-kia.

decisions.choice: my servant: a title of honor for one God chooses
decisions.reason: God gives the title to David (37:35) and to Isaiah (20:3). It sets Eliakim, chosen by God, against Shebna, who served himself.

decisions.choice: Eliakim son of Hilkiah
decisions.reason: Eliakim is over the palace in 36:3, 22 and 37:2 (2 Kings 18:18), during Sennacherib's siege in 701 BC.

decisions.choice: "đầy tớ Ta"
decisions.reason: The terms note: God's servants are "đầy tớ" at every level, Literal included, never "nô lệ"; the title honors Eliakim as one God chose.

source.text: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתִּ֣יו כֻּתָּנְתֶּ֗ךָ וְאַבְנֵֽטְךָ֙ אֲחַזְּקֶ֔נּוּ וּמֶֽמְשֶׁלְתְּךָ֖אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּיָד֑וֹ וְהָיָ֥ה לְאָ֛ב לְיוֹשֵׁ֥ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וּלְבֵ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will clothe him [with] your tunic, and [with] your sash I will bind him, and your authority I will put in his hand, and he will become a father to [the] inhabitants of Jerusalem and to [the] house of Judah.

en.L: And I will clothe him [with] your robe, and [with] your sash I will bind him, and your authority I will put in his hand, and he will be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem and to the house of Judah.
en.B: I will dress him in your robe and bind your sash on him. I will place your authority in his hand, and he will be a father to the people of Jerusalem and to the house of Judah.
en.R: I will put your robe and your belt on him. I will give him your power. He will take care of the people of Jerusalem and Judah like a father.

es.L: Y lo vestiré [con] tu túnica, y [con] tu faja lo ceñiré, y tu autoridad pondré en su mano, y será un padre para los habitantes de Jerusalén y para la casa de Judá.
es.B: Lo vestiré con tu túnica y le ceñiré tu faja. Pondré tu autoridad en su mano, y será un padre para la gente de Jerusalén y para la casa de Judá.
es.R: Le pondré tu túnica y tu cinturón. Le daré tu poder. Cuidará como un padre a la gente de Jerusalén y de Judá.

fr.L: Et je le revêtirai de ta tunique, et de ta ceinture je le ceindrai, et ton autorité je la mettrai dans sa main, et il sera un père pour les habitants de Jérusalem et pour la maison de Juda.
fr.B: Je l’habillerai de ta tunique et je lui attacherai ta ceinture. Je remettrai ton autorité entre ses mains, et il sera un père pour les habitants de Jérusalem et pour la maison de Juda.
fr.R: Je lui mettrai ta tunique et ta ceinture. Je lui donnerai ton pouvoir. Il prendra soin des gens de Jérusalem et de Juda comme un père.

sw.L: Nami nitamvika kanzu yako, na kwa mshipi wako nitamfunga, na mamlaka yako nitayatia mkononi mwake, naye atakuwa baba kwa wakaaji wa Yerusalemu na kwa nyumba ya Yuda.
sw.B: Nitamvika joho lako na kumfunga mshipi wako. Nitaweka mamlaka yako mkononi mwake, naye atakuwa baba kwa watu wa Yerusalemu na kwa nyumba ya Yuda.
sw.R: Nitamvika joho lako na mkanda wako. Nitampa mamlaka yako. Atawatunza watu wa Yerusalemu na Yuda kama baba.

vi.L: Và Ta sẽ mặc cho người áo dài của ngươi, và Ta sẽ thắt đai lưng của ngươi cho người, và quyền hành của ngươi Ta sẽ đặt vào tay người, và người sẽ làm cha cho cư dân Giê-ru-sa-lem và cho nhà Giu-đa.
vi.B: Ta sẽ mặc cho người chiếc áo dài của ngươi, thắt đai lưng của ngươi cho người. Ta sẽ trao quyền hành của ngươi vào tay người, và người sẽ là cha của dân Giê-ru-sa-lem và nhà Giu-đa.
vi.R: Ta sẽ lấy áo và đai lưng của ngươi mà mặc cho người. Ta sẽ trao quyền của ngươi cho người. Người sẽ chăm sóc dân Giê-ru-sa-lem và Giu-đa như một người cha.

decisions.choice: your tunic ... your sash: the robes of office
decisions.reason: The robe and sash marked the official's rank. Taking them from Shebna and putting them on Eliakim transfers the office (compare Numbers 20:26-28).

decisions.choice: a father: a protector and provider
decisions.reason: A father to the people is one who cares for them (Job 29:16), unlike Shebna, who cared for his own fame.

source.text: וְנָתַתִּ֛י מַפְתֵּ֥חַ בֵּית־דָּוִ֖ד עַל־שִׁכְמ֑וֹ וּפָתַח֙ וְאֵ֣ין סֹגֵ֔ר וְסָגַ֖ר וְאֵ֥ין פֹּתֵֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will put [the] key of [the] house of David on his shoulder, and he will open, and there is not [one who] shuts, and he will shut, and there is not [one who] opens.

en.L: And I will put the key of the house of David on his shoulder, and he will open, and there [will be] none shutting, and he will shut, and there [will be] none opening.
en.B: I will lay the key of the house of David on his shoulder. When he opens, no one will close; when he closes, no one will open.
en.R: I will give him the key to the palace of David's family. He will have the power to open doors that no one can close. He will close doors that no one can open.

es.L: Y pondré la llave de la casa de David sobre su hombro, y abrirá, y no [habrá] quien cierre, y cerrará, y no [habrá] quien abra.
es.B: Pondré sobre su hombro la llave de la casa de David. Cuando él abra, nadie cerrará; cuando él cierre, nadie abrirá.
es.R: Le daré la llave del palacio de la familia de David. Tendrá poder para abrir puertas que nadie podrá cerrar, y cerrará puertas que nadie podrá abrir.

fr.L: Et je mettrai la clé de la maison de David sur son épaule, et il ouvrira, et [il n’y aura] personne qui ferme, et il fermera, et [il n’y aura] personne qui ouvre.
fr.B: Je poserai sur son épaule la clé de la maison de David. Quand il ouvrira, nul ne fermera ; quand il fermera, nul n’ouvrira.
fr.R: Je lui donnerai la clé du palais de la famille de David. Il aura le pouvoir d’ouvrir des portes que personne ne pourra fermer, et de fermer des portes que personne ne pourra ouvrir.

sw.L: Nami nitaweka ufunguo wa nyumba ya Daudi begani mwake, naye atafungua, wala hakuna atakayefunga, naye atafunga, wala hakuna atakayefungua.
sw.B: Nitaweka ufunguo wa nyumba ya Daudi begani mwake. Akifungua, hakuna atakayefunga; akifunga, hakuna atakayefungua.
sw.R: Nitampa ufunguo wa ikulu ya jamaa ya Daudi. Atakuwa na mamlaka ya kufungua milango ambayo hakuna mtu anayeweza kuifunga. Atafunga milango ambayo hakuna mtu anayeweza kuifungua.

vi.L: Và Ta sẽ đặt chìa khóa của nhà Đa-vít trên vai người, và người sẽ mở, và không ai đóng; và người sẽ đóng, và không ai mở.
vi.B: Ta sẽ đặt chìa khóa nhà Đa-vít trên vai người. Người mở thì không ai đóng được; người đóng thì không ai mở được.
vi.R: Ta sẽ trao cho người chìa khóa cung điện của dòng họ Đa-vít. Người sẽ có quyền mở những cửa mà không ai đóng lại được, và đóng những cửa mà không ai mở ra được.

decisions.choice: the key ... on his shoulder: the sign of authority over the palace
decisions.reason: The steward held the keys of the royal house and decided who could come in. A large key may have been carried on the shoulder, or the phrase pictures the weight of the office (9:5).

decisions.choice: the key of David: applied to Christ
decisions.reason: Revelation 3:7 takes up these words for the risen Christ, who "has the key of David" and opens what no one can shut.

decisions.choice: the power to ... doors
decisions.reason: Readable says that opening and shutting picture full authority over the palace.

source.text: וּתְקַעְתִּ֥יו יָתֵ֖ד בְּמָק֣וֹם נֶאֱמָ֑ן וְהָיָ֛ה לְכִסֵּ֥א כָב֖וֹד לְבֵ֥ית אָבִֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will drive him [as] a peg in a place firm, and he will become a seat of honor for [the] house of his father.

en.L: And I will drive him [like] a peg into a firm place, and he will become a throne of honor for the house of his father.
en.B: I will drive him in like a peg where the ground holds fast, and he will be a seat of honor for his father's house.
en.R: I will make him firm, like a tent peg hammered into solid ground. He will bring honor to his father's family.

es.L: Y lo clavaré [como] una estaca en un lugar firme, y será un trono de honra para la casa de su padre.
es.B: Lo hincaré como una estaca en terreno firme, y será un asiento de honra para la casa de su padre.
